verdict.rationale: YYLO lets users pass natural-language task descriptions (e.g. `yy init --task "..."` or `yy pi 'Summarize this repository...'`) that get executed by coding-agent subagents, but the CLI itself is operated via structured subcommands (init, loop, ledger, merge) rather than a free-form conversational interface. Missing for 10: evidence of a true NL command parser/chat-style control plane, and independent confirmation that arbitrary natural-language instructions (beyond the --task/pi prompt fields) can drive the tool's own operations.
